title: Introduce rate-decoupler and ephemeral failfast probe for graceful regional downgrades
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduces a rate-decoupler and ephemeral failfast probe to reduce regional SLO churn during transient egress pressure. Configurable via runtime flags and defaults disabled for Dedicated/Private until validated.
description: Motivation: We observed repeated SLO thrash during intermittent egress constraints in EU-west, where the controller oscillates between full routing and aggressive regional fallbacks. This PR adds a rate-decoupler layer and a short-lived failfast probe to reduce noisy circuit flips and provide a predictable soft-degradation window. Summary of changes: 1) Rate-decoupler: an admission adapter that maintains a small token buffer decoupling incoming request rate from the backend dispatch rate for up to configured headroom (defaults: 200ms burst, 1s smoothing window). This allows brief upstream surges to burst through without triggering immediate tenant-level circuit actions. 2) Ephemeral failfast probe: a lightweight probe that runs a fast path health check against the region's egress mesh; if the probe detects transient egress saturation it will open an ephemeral failfast (30s by default) which signals dependent components to enter short soft-degrade mode instead of firing long-lived circuit breakers. 3) Telemetry and safeties: new metrics (rate_decoupler.* and ephemeral_probe.*), a debug-only trace hook for request lineage through the decoupler, and automatic escalation to existing SLO enforcer after repeated ephemeral failfasts. 4) Config & rollout: feature gated behind runtime flag "enable_rate_decoupler" (default: false in hosted main), and added canary rollout knobs in the console to enable per-region and per-tenant overrides. Compatibility: No API changes. This is purely a serving runtime adapter. Why this is different: previous mitigations relied on immediate tenant-circuit flips which caused collateral degradation for unaffected tenants; the decoupler tolerates millisecond bursts and the ephemeral probe provides a short, auditable degradation window so the system prefers soft degrade over wholesale circuiting. Metrics to watch: p99 latency, rate_decoupler.buffer_fill, ephemeral_probe.failures, slo_enforcer.invocations. Rollout plan: canary 1% EU-west for 24h -> 10% with autoscaled monitoring -> full region. If metrics indicate increased p99 or error rates, roll back feature flag and disable automatic escalation. Related tickets: ENG-2230 implements the adapter, ENG-2247 contains integration tests, SUP-9812 traced customer incident where oscillations were observed.

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Can we bound the memory impact of the token buffer under heavy tenant churn? Suggest adding a hard cap per node.
Maya Chen: Added per-node hard cap and eviction policy; described limits in config comments. See decoupler.go lines 120-145.
Priya Nair: We need to ensure the ephemeral failfast doesn't suppress important 5xx signals used by SLO enforcer. Please add an escalation path.
Maya Chen: Added automatic escalation that converts three ephemeral failfasts within 5 minutes to a standard SLO enforcer invocation (configurable).
Samuel Ortiz: CI flake on probe integration -- looks like test harness port conflict. Re-ran CI after changing ephemeral port selection.
Maya Chen: Confirmed; made probe port selection randomized in test harness and added retry logic.
notes_for_ops: Ops: enable feature gate via runtime flag rather than cluster restart. For hosted canary use console -> feature flags -> enable_rate_decoupler for eu-west-1 at 1%. Watch metrics: rate_decoupler.buffer_fill, ephemeral_probe.open_count, slo_enforcer.escalations. If buffer_fill remains >90% for >10m, disable immediately to avoid backlog.
test_plan: Unit tests added for token buffer semantics. Integration harness simulates egress saturation and asserts ephemeral probe opens for <60s and then closes. Manual smoke: deploy to dev region with flag on, inject short 2x normal egress latency spike and confirm soft degrade signals observed but no tenant circuit flips. Metrics validated in the stress harness (see test/probe_integration.sh).
rollback_plan: Flip runtime flag enable_rate_decoupler=false in console; disable per-region overrides if set. If rollback fails to stop degradation, revert the merged commit in main and redeploy. Record incident and escalate to runtime team.
